source_files.provenance: Unchanged preserved helper; hash checked against legacy_inventory.json

dependency_lock.provenance: Pinned reconstructed capture environment; historical environment unavailable

inputs.provenance: Deliberately selected redistributable manual inputs. Module numbers transcribed from unchanged legacy Placa_Prueba, not a catalog or measured specimen. Comparison values below are constructed test inputs, not observations or empirical evidence.

outputs.provenance: Independently executed original IV_R; no SUNERGY runtime imported

units_and_coefficients.module: Vmax60,Voc: V; Imax,Isc: A; Pmax: W; alpha,beta,deltha: percent/degC; cells_in_series: count; temp_ref: degC
units_and_coefficients.condition: Geff: effective irradiance W/m2; Tcell: cell temperature degC; Isc,Im: A; Voc,Vm: V; Potencia: W
units_and_coefficients.fit: alpha_sc=(alpha/100)*Isc A/degC; beta_voc=(beta/100)*Voc V/degC; gamma_pmp=deltha percent/degC; forced monoSi and 25 degC
units_and_coefficients.desoto: alpha_sc is raw module alpha, interpreted by pvlib as A/degC (legacy inconsistency preserved); EgRef=1.121 eV,dEgdT=-0.0002677 1/K; default irrad_ref=1000 W/m2,temp_ref=25 degC
units_and_coefficients.fit_parameters: I_L_ref,I_o_ref: A; R_s,R_sh_ref: ohm; a_ref: V; Adjust: percent (unused by IV_R)
units_and_coefficients.desoto_parameters: photocurrent,saturation_current: A; resistance_series,resistance_shunt: ohm; nNsVth: V
units_and_coefficients.curves: voltage,reverse_voltage: V; current,reverse_current: A; singlediode i_sc,i_mp,i_x,i_xx: A; v_oc,v_mp: V;p_mp: W
units_and_coefficients.table: First five error columns are percentage rounded to 2 decimals; Irradiancia W/m2 and T_cell degC rounded to 2 decimals by legacy code

time_convention: No time series or location: explicit ordered steady-state G/T points; no timezone, interval, DST or annual integration

model_solver_grid.model: legacy-IV_R-v1 CEC/SAM fit -> De Soto -> Lambert W
model_solver_grid.grid: np.linspace(0,v_oc,100), endpoint=True; ordered current calculated at every voltage; no resampling
model_solver_grid.unused_reverse_grid: np.linspace(15.948434,0,100) and v_from_i(method='lambertw'); retained as evidence though not returned by original function
model_solver_grid.solver_settings: pvlib0.13.1 defaults, no additional tolerance supplied; PySAM7.1.0 SSC SixParsolve defaults

wrapper.provenance: Inspectable AST selection and transparent real-library call recording; no numerical source edit

model_solver_grid.isolation: Fresh subprocess and temporary CWD; no full helper/UI import; socket connect/create_connection blocked; original source immutable
model_solver_grid.review_limits: Representative selected function only; reconstructed dependency environment; manually supplied comparison values are not measurements; no full dashboard, annual, correction or empirical claim

randomness_notes: Selected IV_R path has no RNG calls; SSC fitting is deterministic under these pinned dependencies

current.rationale: Double-precision same-version deterministic replay; near-zero floor is 1 nA. Independent recapture is exact on capture host; cross-platform limits need CI evidence.

voltage.rationale: Double-precision same-version deterministic replay including Lambert W/Newton internal solves; 10 nV near-zero floor. Cross-platform limits need CI evidence.

power.rationale: Product of current and voltage, propagating the selected A/V floors at the selected 250/400 W module scales; no accuracy claim.

saturation_current.rationale: Dark currents are near 1e-10 A in these captures; a 1e-20 A floor retains sensitivity to relative changes. Same-host replay is exact; cross-platform limits need CI evidence.

resistance.rationale: Same pinned deterministic fit and algebraic rescaling; 1 nano-ohm floor. Cross-platform limits need CI evidence.

adjust.rationale: Same pinned SSC deterministic fit; 1e-9 percentage-point floor. Adjust is captured despite legacy leaving it unused; cross-platform review pending.

review_status: Independently captured and replayed on the capture host; compatibility thresholds proposed for these cases, cross-platform verification pending; not scientific or empirical validation
